en: A song of ascents. Out of the depths I called You, Havayah.

he: אֲדֹנָי֮ שִׁמְעָ֢ה בְק֫וֹלִ֥י תִּהְיֶ֣ינָה אׇ֭זְנֶיךָ קַשֻּׁב֑וֹת לְ֝ק֗וֹל תַּחֲנוּנָֽי׃
en: Ado-noi, hear my voice; let Your ears be attentive to the voice of my supplications.
If You, Yah, keep account of iniquities — Ado-noi, who shall stand?
For with You is forgiveness, that You may be feared.

he: קִוִּ֣יתִי יְ֭הֹוָה קִוְּתָ֣ה נַפְשִׁ֑י וְֽלִדְבָר֥וֹ הוֹחָֽלְתִּי׃
en: I hoped for Havayah; my soul hoped, and for His word I waited.

he: נַפְשִׁ֥י לַאדֹנָ֑י מִשֹּׁמְרִ֥ים לַ֝בֹּ֗קֶר שֹׁמְרִ֥ים לַבֹּֽקֶר׃
en: My soul for Ado-noi — more than watchmen for the morning, watchmen for the morning.

he: יַחֵ֥ל יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֶל־יְ֫הֹוָ֥ה כִּֽי־עִם־יְהֹוָ֥ה הַחֶ֑סֶד וְהַרְבֵּ֖ה עִמּ֣וֹ פְדֽוּת׃
en: Yisrael, hope to Havayah, for with Havayah is kindness, and abundant redemption is with Him.
He shall redeem Yisrael from all his iniquities. [Paragraph break — petuchah, an open paragraph.]
